name: Plank Shoulder Tap
steps: Start in a high-plank position on the floor with your hands directly beneath your shoulders and your feet set slightly wider than hip-width for stability.
Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes firmly to lock your hips in place.
Lift one hand smoothly off the floor to tap your opposite shoulder without letting your hips sway or twist.
Plant that hand back beneath your shoulder and repeat with the other hand, alternating sides on each repetition.
tips: Press actively into the floor with your supporting hand to keep your torso level.
Widen your feet slightly if your hips shift from side to side when lifting a hand.
